content_of_post_to_comment: Why aren’t we just having orgies and feasts all the time? Almost everyone I talk to spends about a third of the workday actually working That’s a lot of orgy and feast time spent playing pretend What the hell guys
comment: Maybe the strange part is that work itself has become a social ritual: we don't just produce things, we perform being useful. The question is less why we aren't feasting, and more why we need the performance at all.
